The bags are available for purchase at Trader Joe's locations, and fans are encouraged to visit soon, as these items tend to sell out quickly. This initiative not only adds a fun element to Halloween shopping but also promotes sustainability through reusable bags.

cards.headline: USPS Launches Operation Santa, Inviting El Pasoans to Adopt Holiday Letters

inlines.text: The U.S. Postal Service has begun its annual Operation Santa, inviting residents to send letters to Santa Claus. This cherished initiative, which has been running since 1912, allows individuals to adopt letters from children and fulfill their holiday wishes. This year, El Pasoans are encouraged to participate and spread joy during the festive season. The program not only brings smiles to children's faces but also fosters community spirit by connecting donors with those in need.

cards.headline: Trump Retains Colombia's Drug Certification Status Amid New Leadership

inlines.text: President Donald Trump has decided to keep Colombia on the list of countries that have failed to meet U.S. drug control obligations, a designation it received a year ago. This decision comes as Colombia's new president, Abelardo de La Espriella, has committed to an aggressive anti-drug campaign. Trump indicated that if Colombia makes significant progress in dismantling narcoterrorist networks, he may reconsider its status in the future. The U.S. also recognizes Mexico's efforts against drug trafficking but emphasizes the need for further action. Meanwhile, Venezuela has been removed from the descertification list due to improved cooperation against drug cartels under its interim government.
Key Details:

items.text: Colombia remains on the U.S. descertification list for drug control as of 2025.
President Abelardo de La Espriella has pledged to combat coca cultivation and cocaine production.
Mexico is urged to enhance efforts against narcoterrorist organizations.
Venezuela's status has changed due to improved cooperation against drug trafficking.

cards.headline: New Study Confirms T. rex Was Warm-Blooded, Changing Our Understanding of Dinosaurs

inlines.text: Recent research has confirmed that Tyrannosaurus rex had a body temperature of approximately 97 degrees Fahrenheit, indicating it was warm-blooded. This finding, published in the journal Science Advances, is based on chemical analysis of fossilized teeth and adds to evidence that T. rex could thrive in colder climates. The study enhances our understanding of the dinosaur's behavior, physiology, and ecological interactions during the Late Cretaceous period, around 69 to 66 million years ago. Researchers believe this new method could be applied to other dinosaur species, potentially reshaping our views on their metabolic rates and lifestyles.
Key Details:

items.text: T. rex body temperature estimated at 97°F (36°C), similar to humans.
Study published in Science Advances provides direct evidence of warm-bloodedness.
Research utilized fossilized teeth from a T. rex skeleton at the Natural History Museum of Los Angeles County.
Technique could be applied to other dinosaurs to explore their metabolic rates.

cards.headline: EPISD Raises Tax Rate, Impacting Homeowners in El Paso

inlines.text: The El Paso Independent School District (EPISD) board has approved a new tax rate that will increase the average homeowner's tax bill by approximately $114 annually. The new rate is set at $1.0745 per $100 of taxable property valuation, which is slightly below the maximum rate allowed by voters. This change raises the average tax due on homes from $1,179 last year to $1,294.18 this year, reflecting a rise in average taxable home values from $109,167 to $120,455. Homeowners should be aware of exemptions available, including a $140,000 exemption for most homeowners and additional exemptions for seniors and disabled individuals.
Key Details:

items.text: New tax rate approved at $1.0745 per $100 of property valuation.
Average homeowner's tax bill increases from $1,179 to $1,294.18.
First $140,000 of property value is exempt from school taxes for most homeowners.
Additional $60,000 exemption for seniors and disabled individuals.
Veterans with 100% disability rating are exempt from all property taxes.

cards.headline: Fredd Young, NMSU Football Legend and NFL Star, Passes Away at 64

inlines.text: Fredd Young, a celebrated Hall of Famer from New Mexico State University (NMSU) and former Seattle Seahawks player, has died at the age of 64. Young was a standout linebacker for the Aggies from 1980 to 1983, setting a record with six sacks in a single game against LA Tech in 1983. Drafted by the Seahawks in 1984, he played seven seasons in the NFL, participating in 101 games and starting 79. His contributions to football and the Las Cruces community were recognized in 1991 when he was inducted into the U.S. Bank/NM State Athletics Hall of Fame. His legacy is remembered fondly by NMSU Athletics, highlighting his significant impact on the sport and local community.
Key Details:

items.text: Fredd Young played for NMSU from 1980-1983.
He was drafted by the Seattle Seahawks in the third round of the 1984 NFL Draft.
Young set a record with six sacks in a single game against LA Tech in 1983.
Inducted into the NMSU Hall of Fame in 1991.
He played a total of 101 NFL games, starting 79.

cards.headline: El Paso Animal Services Under Scrutiny Following Rescue Group's Allegations

inlines.text: El Paso Animal Services is currently under investigation due to serious allegations raised by the local nonprofit, Paws for Promise. The organization claims that animals returned from the city's facilities have exhibited health issues, prompting concerns about the procedures in place. A representative from Paws for Promise shared these concerns through a Facebook video, highlighting the potential impact on animal welfare. This situation is significant as it raises questions about the standards of care provided by Animal Services and the implications for local animal rescue efforts.

cards.headline: El Paso Residents Urged to Monitor Pets for New World Screwworm Threat

inlines.text: Health officials are alerting El Paso pet owners about the potential threat of the New World screwworm, a flesh-eating fly larva recently detected in Juárez and other areas in Texas. Although no cases have been reported in El Paso, the parasite can cause severe tissue damage and infection in animals if not treated promptly. Symptoms to watch for include foul-smelling wounds, lethargy, and visible maggots. Pet owners are advised to seek immediate veterinary care if they suspect an infection. Local animal services are prepared for potential cases, emphasizing the importance of preventative measures.
Key Details:

items.text: Monitor pets for symptoms like foul-smelling wounds and lethargy.
Seek veterinary care immediately if infection is suspected.
Stay updated on preventative measures and local health advisories.

cards.headline: Sunny, Beloved Portuguese Water Dog of the Obamas, Passes Away at 13

inlines.text: Sunny, the Portuguese water dog who brought joy to the Obama family during their time in the White House, has died at the age of 13. Former President Barack Obama announced her passing on social media, calling her a cherished family member. Sunny joined the Obamas in 2013, providing companionship to their other dog, Bo, and was known for her playful and spirited personality. Throughout her life, she was involved in various official events and even met Pope Francis. The cause of her death has not been disclosed, but her legacy as a beloved first pet endures, as she helped the Obamas transition to life as empty nesters after their daughters left for college.

cards.headline: House of Representatives Adjourns Early, Dodges Hegseth Impeachment Vote

inlines.text: The Speaker of the House, Mike Johnson, has decided to send lawmakers back to their districts early for a seven-week campaign recess, preventing a scheduled vote on the impeachment of Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. Originally, the House was set to remain in session until Thursday, but will now conclude with key votes on a sanctions bill against Russia on Wednesday night. This decision comes amid growing pressure on Republicans regarding contentious issues and an unexpected impeachment resolution introduced by Representative Thomas Massie. Johnson criticized Massie's actions as a publicity stunt and emphasized that the early adjournment was unrelated to Hegseth's situation. The House will reconvene after the November elections.
Key Details:

items.text: House adjourns early for a seven-week recess before midterm elections.
Final votes will occur on Wednesday night, including a sanctions bill against Russia.
Impeachment resolution against Hegseth introduced by Rep. Thomas Massie delayed until November.
Johnson dismisses Massie's impeachment initiative as a publicity stunt.

cards.headline: Majority of Teachers Support Limits on Student Screen Time in Schools

inlines.text: A recent Gallup poll reveals that nearly 75% of teachers are advocating for restrictions on screen time for students in classrooms. While educators recognize the role of technology in learning, many express concerns about its overuse and potential negative impacts on student engagement and health. This sentiment underscores a growing debate about the balance between digital learning tools and traditional teaching methods. The findings highlight the need for school districts to consider policies that address screen time in order to enhance educational outcomes.

Among the newly included terms are 'looksmaxxing,' which refers to efforts to enhance one's appearance, and 'rickroll,' a popular internet prank. This update highlights the dynamic nature of language and its adaptation to cultural phenomena. The inclusion of these terms allows users to better understand contemporary discussions and online interactions.

cards.headline: Supreme Court Ruling on Mail-In Voting Seen as Win for Democracy

inlines.text: The U.S. Supreme Court's recent decision to block former President Trump's attempts to restrict mail-in voting for the 2026 midterm elections has sparked varied reactions, primarily from Democrats who benefit more from this voting method. While Trump argues that such changes favor Republicans, analysts suggest that the ruling may ultimately enhance democratic participation rather than just benefiting one party. A recent CBS News poll indicates that 38% of Democrats plan to vote by mail compared to 22% of Republicans, highlighting the importance of mail-in voting for older and rural voters, who tend to lean Republican. Concerns remain about the potential for errors in the mail-in voting verification process, which could disenfranchise voters across party lines.
Key Details:

items.text: Supreme Court decision blocks Trump's mail-in voting restrictions for 2026 elections.
CBS News poll shows 38% of Democrats vs. 22% of Republicans plan to vote by mail.
Older and rural voters, more likely to vote by mail, are crucial for both parties.
Concerns about mail-in voting verification errors could impact voter turnout.

cards.headline: Crisis de agua en EE.UU.: Niveles históricos bajos en embalses clave afectan a millones

inlines.text: Los niveles de agua en Lake Powell y Lake Mead han alcanzado cifras históricamente bajas, lo que representa un grave problema para el suministro de agua y energía en el suroeste de EE.UU. A partir del 12 de julio, Lake Powell estaba a 3,524 pies y Lake Mead a 1,043 pies, rompiendo récords anteriores. Estos embalses son cruciales, ya que abastecen agua a 40 millones de personas y generan electricidad para 700,000 hogares. Con el 95% de la cuenca del río Colorado en sequía, se prevé que los niveles sigan cayendo, lo que podría llevar a una crisis en la gestión del agua entre los siete estados que dependen de este recurso. Las negociaciones para compartir el agua se complican, y se espera que nuevas directrices operativas se publiquen en las próximas semanas para abordar la crisis.
Key Details:

items.text: Lake Powell actualmente al 23% de su capacidad, y Lake Mead al 27%.
Se espera que ambos embalses establezcan nuevos mínimos históricos diariamente hasta la primavera de 2024.
Se impuso una fecha límite en febrero para que los estados llegaran a un acuerdo sobre la gestión del agua, pero no se alcanzó un consenso.
El Secretario del Interior, Doug Burgum, se reunió con los gobernadores de los siete estados para discutir soluciones.
Se anticipa que El Niño podría traer alivio a la sequía en otoño e invierno.

Violent Gang Attack in Haiti Claims 16 Lives Amid Ongoing Crisis

inlines.text: A brutal attack by the armed gang Gran Grif in Haiti resulted in at least 16 fatalities and numerous injuries on Sunday in Jean Denis, near Port-au-Prince. The gang blocked access routes to prevent police intervention, leading to a delayed response. While the police reported 16 deaths, an NGO claims the toll may be as high as 70, with many homes set ablaze and thousands displaced. The U.S. State Department has labeled Gran Grif as a foreign terrorist organization, noting its significant role in civilian deaths since 2022. Haiti continues to grapple with escalating violence, with a new multinational force expected to arrive in April to help restore order.
Key Details:

items.text: At least 16 confirmed dead; NGO reports suggest 70 fatalities.
Gang Gran Grif has been responsible for 80% of civilian deaths in Artibonite since 2022.
New multinational forces to arrive in April to combat gang violence.

cards.headline: Ucrania intensifica ofensiva contra la infraestructura petrolera rusa en medio de ganancias inesperadas del Kremlin

inlines.text: El Ejército de Ucrania ha intensificado sus ataques a la infraestructura energética de Rusia, apuntando a refinerías y terminales de exportación en un esfuerzo por debilitar una de las principales fuentes de ingresos del Kremlin. En las últimas semanas, se han llevado a cabo al menos diez ataques significativos, incluyendo uno en una refinería en Yaroslavl, que resultó en daños a edificios residenciales. Mientras tanto, Rusia ha visto un aumento en los precios del petróleo, beneficiándose de la flexibilización de algunas sanciones estadounidenses. El presidente ucraniano, Volodymyr Zelensky, ha criticado estas medidas, argumentando que permiten a Rusia continuar sus ataques. Se espera que el gobierno ruso reintroduzca una prohibición a las exportaciones de gasolina a partir del 1 de abril debido a los efectos en el mercado interno.
Key Details:

items.text: Ucrania ha realizado al menos 10 ataques significativos a la infraestructura energética rusa este mes.
El último ataque fue a una refinería en Yaroslavl, causando un incendio y daños a edificios cercanos.
Se espera que Rusia reintroduzca una prohibición a las exportaciones de gasolina a partir del 1 de abril.
El presupuesto estatal de Rusia depende de los ingresos petroleros, que han aumentado en el último mes.
